description: Production builds you can inspect today - plus how we engineered this site as a live reference.

intro.paragraph1: Real builds in production means exactly that - sites with live traffic, real checkout flows, and real customers, not staging environments dressed up for a portfolio. Every project below shipped to a paying client and is still running today, which means the architecture had to survive contact with actual usage, not just a design review.
intro.paragraph2: Each case study breaks down the same way: the challenge we were actually solving, the approach and tech stack we chose and why, and the measurable results after launch. <dim>Open the live site alongside the write-up</dim> - inspect the network tab, check the Lighthouse score yourself - then read why we built it that way.

labels.liveProofBody: Two production builds are live today - inspect the sites, then read the case studies for scope and architecture.
